name: chtrailing
summary: This EA is a channel-based trailing stop utility that manages existing positions by moving stop losses according to a highest-high/lowest-low channel with an offset. It also implements a 'noose' trailing mechanism that mirrors the take-profit distance to set a symmetric stop loss, and optionally deletes pending orders when a position is opened.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于通道的移动止损工具，根据最高价/最低价通道加减偏移来管理已有持仓的止损。它还实现了'绞索'追踪机制，将止盈距离镜像对称设置为止损，并在持仓建立时可选删除挂单。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA不是一个独立开仓的交易策略，而是一个止损管理工具。它基于指定周期内的最高价和最低价构建通道，将通道上轨加偏移作为空头止损，通道下轨减偏移作为多头止损。入场条件：EA本身不执行入场操作，仅管理已有持仓的止损。出场条件：当通道下轨上移超过当前多头止损时，上移止损；当通道上轨下移低于当前空头止损时，下移止损；'绞索'机制则将止损设在以止盈为镜像的对称位置，随价格推进不断收紧。仓位管理：EA不涉及仓位大小设置，仅修改止损和保留原止盈。资金管理：无资金管理逻辑，不计算风险比例或动态调整仓位。额外功能包括在新仓位成交时自动删除同品种挂单。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trailing stop management utility rather than an independent entry strategy. It constructs a channel from the highest high and lowest low over a user-defined lookback period, adding a point offset to form upper and lower trailing levels. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open positions — it only manages stop losses on existing ones. Exit conditions for long positions trigger when the channel lower bound moves above the current stop loss, tightening the stop; for short positions, when the channel upper bound moves below the current stop loss. The 'noose' trailing mechanism mirrors the take-profit distance from the current price to set a symmetric stop loss, progressively locking in profit as price moves favorably. Position sizing and money management are entirely absent — the EA only modifies stop loss and preserves the existing take profit. An auxiliary feature deletes all pending orders for the symbol when a deal is added and a position exists.

parameters.name: trail_period
parameters.description: 通道计算周期，用于回溯最高价/最低价
parameters.description_en: Channel period for highest/lowest price lookback

parameters.name: trail_stop
parameters.description: 通道偏移点数，在通道上下轨外额外加减的距离
parameters.description_en: Channel offset points added beyond upper/lower band

parameters.name: noose_trailing
parameters.description: 是否启用'绞索'追踪止损（镜像止盈距离）

parameters.name: channel_trailing
parameters.description: 是否启用通道追踪止损

parameters.name: ord_delete
parameters.description: 持仓建立时是否删除同品种挂单
parameters.description_en: Delete pending orders of same symbol when position opens

pros: 双重止损追踪机制（通道+绞索），灵活组合使用
内置止损级别和冻结级别检查，避免无效修改被拒绝
通道偏移可调，适应不同波动率市场
新K线判断机制避免逐tick重复计算，减少资源消耗
可视化通道线和绞索线绘制，便于用户直观监控
pros_en: Dual trailing stop mechanisms (channel + noose) offering flexible combination
Built-in stop level and freeze level validation prevents rejected modification requests
Adjustable channel offset accommodates different volatility regimes
New bar detection avoids per-tick redundant calculations, saving resources
Visual trend line rendering of channel and noose levels for intuitive monitoring
cons: 不执行开仓操作，依赖外部信号或其他EA入场，使用场景受限
无仓位选择逻辑，仅支持单品种单持仓，无法管理多仓组合
绞索机制依赖止盈已设置的前提，未设止盈时绞索完全不生效且无提示
无错误处理反馈，PositionModify失败时用户无法得知原因
通道周期固定为5，在高波动或低波动市场中可能需要频繁手动调整
cons_en: Does not open positions, relying on external signals or other EAs for entry, limiting standalone use
No multi-position support — only manages a single position per symbol
Noose mechanism requires take-profit to be pre-set; if TP is zero, noose silently does nothing without alerting the user
No error handling feedback — PositionModify failures are not reported to the user
Fixed default channel period of 5 may require frequent manual adjustment across different volatility environments
improvements: 增加日志和错误反馈机制，记录止损修改失败原因以便排查
支持多仓位管理和多品种同时追踪，提升实用性
增加通道周期的自适应计算（如ATR倍数），减少手动调参需求
improvements_en: Add logging and error feedback to report PositionModify failure reasons for easier troubleshooting
Support multi-position management and multi-symbol concurrent trailing for greater utility
Implement adaptive channel period calculation (e.g., ATR-based) to reduce manual parameter tuning

risk_points: 绞索机制在未设止盈时静默失效，用户可能误以为止损正在被管理
通道止损在新K线时才更新，剧烈波动的tick间可能存在止损滞后
risk_points_en: Noose mechanism silently fails when take-profit is not set, potentially misleading users into thinking stops are being managed
Channel trailing only updates on new bars, creating potential stop lag during volatile intra-bar moves

It also implements a 'noose' trailing mechanism that mirrors the take-profit distance to set a symmetric stop loss, and optionally deletes pending orders when a position is opened.
